summary: The source performs a separate warm-up launch, then a timed count-controlled launch loop, synchronization and output copy. Each CUDA thread covers one row and loops through its CSR range. All six configured architecture variants retain that nonzero multiply/add traversal, its backward loop edge, and a row store.

source_evidence.claim: Thread-to-row bound, complete CSR loop and output store are explicit. CLI n/s/i determine the matrix and count; initialized operands feed a separate warm-up and then the measured repeated launch loop, synchronization, timer stop and result copy.
Configured CUDA architectures 70, 75, 80, 86, 89 and 90 are all represented in the final SASS inspected.

compiled_evidence.claim: The pre-timing launch and device sync end before clock call at 831. The measured loop launches through stub at 860 and retains count increment/compare/backedge at 836-861; post-loop cudaDeviceSynchronize at 867 precedes stop clock at 870.

compiled_evidence.claim: Each sm_70/75/80/86/89/90 function compares its row index with dim and exits invalid threads. The per-function body ranges show CSR-controlled multiply/add arithmetic and backward loop edges; the tail ranges show STG stores for the row results.
